title: Atlan Bulk Export and Download Audit
app: Atlan audit logs via the Atlan API to HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=atlan:audit (action="*EXPORT*" OR action="*DOWNLOAD*")
| stats count as exports, sum(coalesce(row_count,rows,record_count)) as rows by user_name
| eventstats avg(rows) as avg_rows, stdev(rows) as sd_rows
| where rows>avg_rows+3*sd_rows
| sort - rows
description: Watches Atlan for users exporting or downloading unusually large volumes of data, a signal for both data-exfiltration risk and ungoverned spreadsheet sprawl.
value: Large exports move governed data out of Atlan where it can no longer be controlled; anomaly detection flags the risky ones for review.
implementation: Ingest Atlan export/download events with row counts; schedule daily and alert on 3-sigma export-volume anomalies per user.
visualization: Table of user by export volume, anomaly markers.
grandmaExplanation: We notice when someone pulls an unusually large amount of data out of Atlan so it can be checked.
